## Taxonomic Classification

I examined instructor-provided GTDB-Tk results to identify
microorganisms recovered from the black band disease metagenome.
The taxonomic classifications were generated using the Genome
Taxonomy Database.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome
head -n 8 /pvol/data/mg/bbd/gtdbtk/out/classify/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv | cut -f 1,2
```

### Results and Interpretation

The recovered genome bins represented multiple bacterial groups,
including Cyanobacteria, Bacteroidota, Desulfobacterota, and
Campylobacterota.

Of particular interest, `metabat.26` was classified within
*Roseofilum*, a cyanobacterial genus associated with black
band disease. This bin also showed high estimated completeness
(97.56%) and low contamination (0.67%).

The identification of diverse bacterial groups is consistent
with the complex microbial communities associated with black
band disease. However, taxonomic classification alone cannot
establish the ecological function or pathogenic role of each
organism.
